parent_objective: design diagnostic-control repairs before any longer profile comparison
blocked_by: M1201 finds high current-frame substitution risk for L2 older history and a reset-control evaluation semantic artifact
supersedes: directly repeating M1199 without corrected reset evaluation and capacity-matched current-tiled L2 controls
invalidates: using M1199 L3_reset_control aggregate as a true reset-hidden diagnostic

public_gates: M1202 must not run candidate replay
M1202 must not use private holdout
M1202 must not claim paper-level evidence or self-identification
forbidden_shortcuts: do not rerun the comparison before reset evaluation semantics are fixed
do not claim finite-window history necessity without a current-tiled capacity control
do not tune one profile after M1199
do not add hidden or oracle actor inputs

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_profile_control_repair: reset semantics and current-tiled L2 control
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs the control repairs needed to make the next profile comparison interpretable
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no training promotion private-holdout paper-level generalization recurrent-belief or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if reset_hidden_policy cannot be represented in public evaluation tooling
stop if a current-tiled L2 control would change non-history inputs or actor capacity
stop if repair would require profile-specific tuning
stop if the repair cannot be tested without private holdout
fallback_plan: route to evaluator implementation if reset semantics are straightforward
route to controller-profile runtime implementation if current-tiled L2 needs a wrapper
route to benchmark redesign if controls cannot isolate history from capacity
route to synthesis if the branch cadence fires before implementation
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1201 identifies diagnostic control gaps that block longer comparison

admission_evidence: M1201 verifies profile configs and L2 observation stacks are nonidentical
M1201 finds L2 older-current-tiled action sensitivity is near zero
M1201 finds L3_reset_control external eval did not enforce every-step reset semantics
blocked_shortcuts: do not train controllers in M1202
do not make paper-level or self-ID claims
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: reset evaluation semantic repair is specified
current-tiled L2 capacity control is specified
focused tests and rerun protocol are specified
next implementation or synthesis milestone is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1201 shows current-frame substitution risk is high for L2 older-history ablation, so M1202 must design controls that separate history use from current-frame and encoder-capacity effects.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: No new temporal evidence is claimed in M1202; it designs the controls required for later evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Treat near-zero older-current-tiled action sensitivity and reset-control metric artifact as process blockers, not as reasons to lower self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: The next fair comparison can be made interpretable by designing reset-evaluation semantics and a capacity-matched current-tiled L2 control before more training.
success_criteria: current-tiled L2 capacity control is specified
focused tests and rerun protocol are specified
no training, PPO, candidate replay, promotion, private holdout, per-profile tuning, or actor-input contract change occurs
next implementation or synthesis milestone is selected
failure_criteria: M1202 treats repair design as performance evidence
hidden or oracle actor inputs are introduced
design fails to address either reset semantics or L2 capacity control

commands.name: design_profile_control_repairs
commands.command: write reset-eval and current-tiled L2 control design without training

decision_rule: M1202 passes if it designs the diagnostic-control repairs needed for an interpretable rerun without training, tuning, promotion, private holdout, or claim expansion.
